create_parallel_wavegan_model: create a ParallelWaveGAN vocoder model with generator and discriminator configured via dataclass configs
train_parallel_wavegan_step: train the ParallelWaveGAN model for one step computing generator and discriminator losses
generate_waveform_from_spectrogram: generate a waveform from a spectrogram using the trained ParallelWaveGAN generator
compute_validation_losses: compute validation losses for the ParallelWaveGAN model including spectral and adversarial losses
get_model_complexity: get the FLOPS and parameter count of the ParallelWaveGAN generator model
